modelIndicator.construction: Actual thumb-component fold facet50 independently read from each side probe; proximal direction checked against distal phalanx base and IP articulation. Model line intersection is at radial nail-base corner, not a painted skin landmark.
limitations: No observed nail-fold skin colour or palpable accuracy; original probe membership retained.

landmarks.anatomy: Proximal direction beside radial distal phalanx

modelIndicator.construction: Actual distal phalanx facet49 directs the path proximally from nail corner, retaining radial contour.
Native proximal-phalangeal distal articulation facets define an authored thumb IP-level caliper. Full surface width at these addressed sides calibrates 1 F-cun; no source IP skin crease is asserted.
limitations: Teaching joint-width correspondence; individual skin crease and clinical finger-cun accuracy not established.
